label: Home maintenance
h1: The home maintenance calendar: three jobs a month

items.b:
This month's three jobs (about an hour in total):
• Replace the HVAC filter for heating season.
• Check smoke and CO alarms.
• Put non-slip mats where floors get wet.

Helping a parent? Do the safety items (rails, lights, mats, trip hazards) at their place too.

This month's three jobs (about an hour in total):
• Check holiday light cords for damage.
• Know where the main water shut-off is and label it.
• Clear snow and ice paths; stock ice melt.

Helping a parent? Do the safety items (rails, lights, mats, trip hazards) at their place too.
